title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Cartwise+ Membership and the Categories Held Under the Exit Cashback Cap
content:
**Card program terms, clause on exit settlements.** When a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account moves off the Everyday Pay Card plans, which merchant categories the exit cap covers depends on the shopper's Cartwise+ Membership: a shopper holding an active Cartwise+ Premier Annual or Cartwise+ Family Annual membership has the cap cover fuel and EV charging only, with auto maintenance added on top; a shopper holding any other active Cartwise+ membership has the cap cover fuel and auto maintenance only, with EV charging added on top; a shopper with no active Cartwise+ membership has the cap cover the month's total.

"Added on top" means that category's cashback for the settlement's statement month is added in full to the capped figure and is not held under the cap. The membership read is the shopper's Cartwise+ Membership that is active on the day of the move, by its plan name.

| Active Cartwise+ Membership on the day of the move | Held under the exit cap | Added on top, uncapped |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual or Cartwise+ Family Annual | fuel and EV charging | auto maintenance |
| any other active Cartwise+ Membership plan | fuel and auto maintenance | EV charging |
| none active | fuel, EV charging and auto maintenance together | nothing |

### Illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

The statement month's cashback is fuel 14.00, EV charging 6.00 and auto maintenance 5.00, and the exit cap is 16.00.

- Active Cartwise+ Family Annual: fuel and EV charging total 20.00, held to 16.00; auto maintenance 5.00 added on top; the month's capped figure is 21.00.
- Active Cartwise+ Monthly: fuel and auto maintenance total 19.00, held to 16.00; EV charging 6.00 added on top; the month's capped figure is 22.00.
- No active membership: the month's total 25.00, held to 16.00.

A membership that is not active on the day of the move counts as no active membership.
